name: MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.CAR.separableCounterexampleRepresentation
title: The fixed algebra on the CAR trace Hilbert space

content.display_title: The fixed algebra on the CAR trace Hilbert space
content.one_sentence_role: Defines a representation of the same algebra $T$ on the GNS Hilbert space of the CAR trace.
content.natural_language_statement: Let $A$ be the completed CAR algebra and $T=C^*(\pi(A)\cup\{L_i:i\in I\})\subseteq B(\mathcal H)$ the algebra generated by the selected direct sum $\pi$ of pure-state GNS representations indexed by their unitary-equivalence classes $i\in I$ and the unitaries $L_i$ from the fixed homogeneity and shell construction. Write $\iota(a)=\pi(a)$ for the embedding $A\to T$. Let $\tau$ be the normalized CAR trace, $H_\tau=L^2(A,\tau)$ its GNS Hilbert space, and $\pi_\tau$ its GNS representation. Let $\phi$ be the chosen state on $T$ with $\phi\circ\iota=\tau$, and let $(H_\phi,\rho_\phi,\xi_\phi)$ be its GNS representation with cyclic vector. The cited trace construction provides a chosen unitary $E:H_\tau\to H_\phi$ carrying the canonical trace vector to $\xi_\phi$ and intertwining the two representations of $A$. Define $$\widetilde\rho(t)=E^{-1}\rho_\phi(t)E\qquad(t\in T).$$
content.definition_explanation: The representation is obtained by conjugating $\rho_\phi$ with the same chosen unitary $E:H_\tau\to H_\phi$: $\widetilde\rho(t)=E^{-1}\rho_\phi(t)E$. Its operators therefore act on $H_\tau$, not on $H_\phi$.
content.assumptions: The algebra $T$ and the state extension $\phi$ are fixed as in the cited construction. The same unitary $E$ is used throughout. The Hilbert space $H_\tau$ is determined by $A$ and $\tau$, independently of the added unitaries $L_i$.
content.conclusion: This is a unital $*$-representation $\widetilde\rho:T\to B(H_\tau)$. It extends the CAR trace representation in the sense that $\widetilde\rho(\iota(a))=\pi_\tau(a)$ for all $a\in A$.
content.lean_realization_notes: The space $H_\tau$ is separable by its dense CAR orbit, and injectivity is a separately cited theorem. Neither fact asserts norm separability of $T$ or irreducibility of this representation.
